title: Customer Success Executive
description:
Customer Success Executive for our digital banking product. Fully remote within India.

Responsibilities:
- Onboard new customers and walk them through KYC and account setup.
- Own email communication and follow-ups through the customer lifecycle.
- Maintain customer records and daily reporting.

Requirements:
- Required: 1-4 years in customer support, customer success or a service role.
- Experience with email communication and confirmation follow-ups.
- Knowledge of KYC and basic banking operations is required.
- Comfortable with MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Nice to have: NSDC or BCBF certification, experience with financial literacy programmes.
